question: how do I get access to Ark?

records.answer: You can get access to Ark by opening the Ark link and following the sign-in process. If you can't see the link, email Bhurva or Abhimanyu with your email and team, or have your lead send a CSV for the whole team at once. Then, log in from the 'Ark' invite email and set a password. Alternatively, you can also open https://ark.internal.ap-south-1.platform.mlops.pai.mypaytm.com on the corp network or VPN, and if the page doesn't load, ask one of your tenant's admins for an account with your email and team name.

Open https://ark.internal.ap-south-1.platform.mlops.pai.mypaytm.com from the corporate network or VPN. If the page won’t load, ask your tenant’s admin for an Ark account by providing your email and team name (or have your lead send a CSV for the whole team). You can also email Bhurva or Abhimanyu with your email + team to request access. After the invite arrives, click the link in the “Ark” invitation email and set a password. Finally, confirm you’re logged in by running `ark auth whoami`, which should show your email, role, and tenant.

Open https://ark.internal.ap-south-1.platform.ml.pai.mypaytm.com while you’re on the corporate network or VPN. If the page doesn’t load, ask your tenant’s admin (you can find them on Settings → Your admins) to create an account for you. You can also email Bhurva or Abhimanyu with your email address and team name, or have your lead send a CSV containing the whole team’s details. After the account is created you’ll receive an "Ark" invite email – follow the link, set a password, and you’ll be able to log in.
